rules.rule_name: Receivables + Revenue Divergence
rules.trigger_condition: Receivables growth materially exceeds revenue growth AND DSRI is elevated and/or DSO increases materially.
rules.evidence_required: Revenue growth; receivables growth; DSRI; DSO; CFO/Revenue
rules.forensic_finding: Multiple independent indicators point to deterioration in revenue-to-cash quality.
rules.why_it_matters: The combination is substantially more informative than any single receivables metric and warrants review of revenue recognition, collectability and period-end sales.
rules.recommended_investigation: Perform customer-level receivable aging, subsequent collections testing and revenue cut-off testing.
rules.question_for_management: What explains the receivable build-up relative to revenue, and how much has been collected after year-end?
rules.management_evidence_requested: Provide supporting schedules and reconciliations for each triggered component.
rules.reference_basis: EFS v1.0 compound forensic rule
rules.notes: Compound rule; do not double-count component scores.

rules.question_for_management: Which specific operating items explain the gap between profit growth and operating cash growth?
